name: Posiflex Technology, Inc.
summary: Posiflex Technology, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial computers and peripheral equipment in Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It offers point of sale (POS) products, including mobile POS, POS terminals, all in one POS, and POS boxes; self-service kiosk; and peripherals, such as POS monitors, line displays, POS printers, cash drawers, POS keyboards, barcode scanners, magnetic stripe card readers, attachment, MT accessories, IO boxes, and base. The company also offers information software, sports, and import and export services; and travel e-commerce platform.
